theorems.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ), ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ (F : Set (Euclid m)) (R C δ : ℝ), MeasurableSet F → 0 ≤ C → 0 < δ → δ * Real.sqrt m ≤ 1 → (∀ h : Euclid m, ‖h‖ ≤ 1 → volume (symmDiff ((fun v => v + h) ⁻¹' F) F ∩ ball (0 : Euclid m) R) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (C * ‖h‖)) → ∫⁻ v in ball (0 : Euclid m) R, ‖F.indicator (fun _ => (1 : ℝ)) v - (volume (F ∩ {w : Euclid m | ∀ j, ⌊w j / δ⌋ = ⌊v j / δ⌋})).toReal / δ ^ m‖ₑ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K * C * δ)
